illustrations.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide website welcome illustration and campaign fallback for a traditional fantasy roleplaying game. Input images: both supplied images are visual style and subject references; use their expressive pencil and ink draftsmanship and fantasy architecture. Create an original scene of a small band of adventurers approaching a distant ruined stone gateway on a wild path, with generous white paper around the composition and no lettering, symbols, logos, or watermark. Traditional hand-drawn fantasy illustration, reminiscent of an illustrator's pencil studies for a classic tabletop RPG rulebook. Graphite pencil and fine ink on warm, pure-white paper. Monochromatic with natural graphite grays. Loose, confident, expressive linework, visible construction lines, overlapping strokes, varied line weight, irregular contours, and organic imperfections. Detailed cross-hatching and directional pencil shading. Some areas carefully rendered while others remain deliberately unfinished. Authentic traditional sketchbook aesthetic, visibly handmade. No watercolor, painted color fills, digital gradients, airbrushing, photorealism, polished digital concept art, or 3D rendering.
